_note: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Design principle (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-robot-reaction-bridge-design.md): valence picks the emotion FAMILY, arousal picks the intensity (1-3). Each family offers 2 pre-approved, valence-consistent candidates -- high valence -> HAPPINESS/LOVE, medium valence -> INTEREST/SURPRISE, low valence -> SADNESS/FEAR (deliberately not ANGER/CONTEMPT/DISGUST -- those read as hostile, wrong register for a robot meant to stay supportive even with critical feedback). Which candidate gets picked: config.EMOTION_LLM_SELECTION_ENABLED=false (default) always picks candidates[0], deterministic, free. =true lets an LLM pick between the two based on actual answer content -- see emotion_bank.py. Emotion names must be values furhat-emotion-study's EmotionLibrary.getEmotion() actually implements: HAPPINESS, FEAR, SADNESS, ANGER, SURPRISE, DISGUST, CONTEMPT, LOVE, SHAME, INTEREST.
